Application to amend Zoning for 137 & 141 Woolwich Street
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built.
Opulence Homes is proposing to build new two townhouse buildings at 137 and 141 Woolwich Street consisting of 11 dwelling units with frontage along Exmoor Street.
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
reducing the minimum lot area to 146 square metres
reducing the minimum interior lot line setback to 2.7 metres from the westerly lot line.
reducing minimum side yard to 1.7 metres
increasing the maximum lot coverage to 50%
exempting townhouse buildings from the required visitor parking
Other amendments identified by staff include:
reducing the minimum landscaped open space to 27% for a freehold townhouse
allow a retaining wall greater 0.6m above grade not to be deemed part of the building
exemption from the cluster development regulations.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Building Height: 9.9 metres (3 storeys)
Number of units: 11
Unit sizes: three bedrooms or two bedrooms with den
Housing types: townhouses
Parking
Parking: 11
Bicycle parking: None
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
